Add one entry for each Mill device. Enter its IP address or hostname. The adapter automatically detects the MAC address and uses it as the device ID.
If "Poll when device is switched off" is unchecked, polling stops as soon as the adapter detects that the device is switched off. A subsequent switch-on performed outside ioBroker will not be detected. Polling resumes only after an adapter restart or when the device is switched on through ioBroker.
